title: planner · Discover and assess 4 primary sources reporting descriptive agent-memo
summary: Discover and assess 4 primary sources reporting descriptive agent-memory metrics (success/hallucination rates) on standard benchmarks under fixed token budgets, explicitly noting missing controlled baselines.
body: 1. Execute targeted searches for agent-memory performance metrics on ScienceWorld/BigBench with fixed token constraints. 2. Inspect top 4 results for success/hallucination rates, resource usage, and benchmark specifics. 3. Document where direct baseline comparisons are absent. 4. If <4 sources match strict criteria, expand to 'descriptive performance' or 'resource usage' while flagging lack of A/B testing. 5. Compile findings into a structured evidence note without code execution.
